_comment: AGU26 arm 2 — the EMISSION-FILTER fix for the churn blocker measured on runs/agu63.
WHY.  On the baseline arm the held-out consumer never resolves a single ambiguity
(0 % fix over 12 h, wandering 3-7 m) while the SAME consumer on the SAME products
reaches ~0.1 m and ~100 % fixed the moment the product stream stops updating.  The
blocker is emitted-product CHURN, not product accuracy.  Measured post-convergence:
the phase-bias channel signals a discontinuity every ~104 min per (sat,signal), and
the arc-age table says an ambiguity needs ~240 epochs (~2 h) to reach resolvable
sigma.  The product resets the user's ambiguity just before it can mature.
THE CHANGE (two knobs, one prescribed pair — NOT a clean single-variable A/B):
1. network.emit_pb_filter_gate_v2 — posture-recommended ON and OFF in every config
on this lineage.  Its own validation record: disc floor 2.6/ep vs v1 85.5/ep
(33x), innovation resets 5707 -> 32 (178x), solve BYTE-IDENTICAL.  It is an
OUTPUTS-only gate on the re-based emission frame (requires
carry_invariant_emit_rebase, which this lineage already runs) and is NOT in the
warm-resume fingerprint, so it changes what the consumer eats and nothing else.
2. network.emit_pb_filter_jump_k 8.0 -> 4.0 (the code default).  The inherited 8.0
is the RETIRED v1 hand tuning; under gate_v2 the gate is model-scaled
(|innov| > k*sqrt(Ppred+R)) so one k transfers across rates and the loader's own
guidance is to retire per-rate overrides once G5 passed.  Arming gate_v2 while
leaving the retired v1 k in place would confound the arm with a stale tuning.
GRADE: the SOLVE must be byte-identical to runs/agu63 (invariant #6 — check products
data lines with ^# stripped, and the network_solution CLK/CB values).  Everything that
moves should move in the EMITTED phase-bias discontinuity rate and, through it, in the
held-out consumer's fix rate and position.
